prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1264; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is currently undergoing medical evaluation and treatment.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly. If you have retained any counsel for your insured, please provide their contact information so that we may correspond with them.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in force at the time of the collision.

We also ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence related to this incident, including vehicle data, photographs, dash camera footage, telematics information, recorded statements, claim file materials, and any communications concerning the collision. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained.
